rules.statement: A servitude of right of way can be validly acquired by prescription over a definite track, and if the path is deviated by mutual agreement without a notarial instrument, the servitude may still attach to the new route depending on whether the incorporeal right remains attached to the old or new path.
rules.supporting_quote: "What is prescribed for by long user is not the ground over which the way lies, but the incorporeal right of servitude ".
